title: FederationRuleUpdateParams
description:
Partial update. Set fields are applied; omitted fields are unchanged.

`issuer_id` is immutable. `match` and `target` are replaced as whole
objects when set. Explicit `null` clears `description` and `attributes`;
other fields can only be replaced, not cleared.

applies_to_all_workspaces.title: Applies To All Workspaces
applies_to_all_workspaces.description: When true, enables this rule for every workspace in the org (including workspaces created later). Setting `false` is rejected with 400 if no workspace would remain enabled; a rule with only a legacy `workspace_id` binding continues to mint.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Replaces the CEL expressions `{name: expr}` extracting named values from claims. Send null to clear them. Not yet supported; any non-empty value is rejected with 400.

description.title: Description
description.description: Replaces the description. Omit to leave unchanged; send `null` to clear (the field is stored as an empty string).

match.description: Replaces the entire match object. All populated matcher fields must pass.

name.title: Name
name.description: Replaces the slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409.

oauth_scope.title: Oauth Scope
oauth_scope.description: Replaces the space-separated OAuth scopes granted on minted tokens. OAuth callers may only set `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`; other scopes (such as `org:admin`) require a Console session.

target.description: Replaces the entire target object. Currently always a `service_account` target.

token_lifetime_seconds.title: Token Lifetime Seconds
token_lifetime_seconds.description: Replaces the lifetime in seconds for access tokens minted via this rule (60-86400). Minted tokens are capped at `max(60, min(this value, 2 × remaining assertion validity))` seconds.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Replaces the existing single workspace enablement (the previous one is removed). Rejected with 400 if the rule is enabled for more than one workspace; use the `/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/workspaces` sub-resource instead.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Exact match against the `aud` claim (any element if array). When omitted, the JWT's `aud` must still equal Anthropic's expected audience for the issuer; setting this field overrides that default.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Exact-match `{claim: value}` pairs against top-level claims. Only string-valued claims can be matched; use `condition` for non-string claims.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: CEL expression over claims for logic the structural fields can't express. Must evaluate to a boolean and may reference only the `claims` variable; a constant-true expression (such as `true`) is rejected with 400.

subject_prefix.title: Subject Prefix
subject_prefix.description: Match the verified JWT `sub` claim. Exact match unless the value ends with `*`, in which case it is a prefix match. Example: `repo:my-org/my-repo:ref:refs/heads/main`.

BetaRuleMatch.title: RuleMatch
BetaRuleMatch.description:
Does the incoming JWT qualify?

All populated fields must pass; omitted fields are skipped. At least one
of `subject_prefix` (other than a wildcard-only value like `*`), `claims`,
or `condition` is required; `audience` alone is not sufficient.

service_account_id.title: Service Account Id
service_account_id.description: Tagged ID of the service account to mint tokens for.

service_account_name.title: Service Account Name
service_account_name.description: Service account's display name at read time. Ignored on writes.

BetaServiceAccountTarget.title: ServiceAccountTarget
BetaServiceAccountTarget.description: Bind to a fixed service account by ID.
